Package io.mavlink4j.testkit

Interface CommandReply

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface CommandReply
What a FakeVehicle does when a scripted command arrives: send zero or more COMMAND_ACKs. Use the factories for the common shapes, or implement it for anything else.
